options.text: Harshit has more solute in the same amount of solvent, so his solution is more concentrated.
Tara's solution is more dilute than Harshit's solution.
Both solutions have the same concentration because both use 200 mL of water.
Harshit's solution is more concentrated because his glass looks fuller.

stem:
Harshit dissolves 4 spoons of sugar in 200 mL of water. Tara dissolves 1 spoon of sugar in 200 mL of water. Both stir until all the sugar dissolves.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: For the same solvent amount, more dissolved sugar means a more concentrated solution and less means more dilute. Equal water volume alone does not equalise concentration.
